premise: The Demon King was killed by the hero. She wakes up reincarnated as a ten-year-old village girl, with all her memories and none of her power.

draft.premise: The Demon King was killed by the hero. She wakes up reincarnated as a ten-year-old village girl, with all her memories and none of her power.

world.title: Rebirth of the Demon King
world.era: Medieval fantasy: iron weapons, horse carriages, and magic crystals

extraordinary.reach: Mages can manipulate the elements, erect protective barriers, and extend their lifespans by cultivating mana.
Extremely powerful souls can sometimes latch onto newborn or empty vessels upon physical death, retaining their past memories.

rules.text: Magic requires physical mana veins in the body, which must be trained and widened over years to channel great power.
The Hero's Holy Blade permanently severs a soul from its active reserves, forcing a reincarnated being to start compiling mana from scratch.
A reincarnated soul eventually reshapes its new physical body to match its original spiritual affinity.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: They live in structured kingdoms, worshipping the Holy Light and training knights and mages to protect their borders.

peoples.name: Demons
peoples.culture: A proud and diverse set of clans who value strength, ancient bloodlines, and direct elemental magic.

creatures.name: Direwolf
creatures.description: Large, ice-breathing wolves that hunt in packs across the northern borders.

nature: Magic crystals glow in response to active mana, serving as light sources and power keys.

rungs.name: 1-Star
rungs.description: Acolytes who can sense mana and light small candles or conjure droplets.

rungs.name: 2-Star
rungs.description: Mages capable of casting standard combat spells and minor barriers.

rungs.name: 3-Star
rungs.description: Masters of magic who can single-handedly turn the tide of local skirmishes.

rungs.name: 4-Star
rungs.description: Archmages who command grand spells, living for centuries.

rungs.name: 5-Star
rungs.description: Grandmasters and sovereign beings whose power shapes territories.

travel.description: People travel on foot, by horse-drawn cart, or on rare flying beasts owned by nobility.

medicine.healing: Minor wounds are mended by water magic and herbal poultices; shattered bones require high-tier holy magic.

laws.text: Every village must pay an annual tribute in grain or mana crystals to the Holy Empire.

norms: Reincarnation and demon worship are considered heresy by the Church of Light.

places.name: Oakhaven
places.description: A quiet, remote farming community nestled against the edge of the Whispering Woods.

places.name: Elvi's Cottage
places.description: A simple wooden home with a thatched roof, smelling of baked bread and dried lavender.

places.name: The Radiant Capital
places.description: The massive, white-walled heart of the Holy Empire, dominated by the spires of the Cathedral of Light.

factions.name: The Holy Empire
factions.description: The dominant human realm, dedicated to the eradication of demon influence.
factions.goal: Consolidate control over former demon territories and hunt down surviving dark beasts.
factions.methods: Deploying holy knights, inquisitorial screening, and establishing border garrisons.
factions.strength: An army of templars and mages, led by the legendary Hero.

npcs.name: Martha
npcs.description: A warm, hard-working farm woman with calloused hands and a gentle smile.
npcs.appearance: Sun-bronzed skin, braided brown hair flecked with gray, wearing a patched linen kirtle.

wants: to see her daughter grow up safe and happy

npcs.name: Aiden
npcs.description: The empire's champion, a young man of unparalleled martial and magical talent who recently defeated the Demon King.
npcs.appearance: Tall and athletic, with striking golden hair, piercing blue eyes, clad in silver plate armor with a glowing holy broadsword at his hip.

wants: to completely cleanse the world of demon remnants

agenda.goal: Verify rumors of surviving demon spirits harboring in the borderlands.
agenda.method: Personally inspecting outer villages under the guise of an imperial tour.

clocks.name: Imperial Mana Testing Caravan
steps: The caravan sets out from the capital with military escorts.
Inspectors reach the regional hub, setting up testing crystals.
The testers arrive in Oakhaven to examine all children for magical aptitude.

threads.title: A New Soul in a Weak Body
threads.stakes: Whether the former Demon King can build up enough power to survive before her true identity is uncovered.

mysteries.question: Why did my soul survive the Hero's Holy Blade and reincarnate here?
mysteries.answer: The Demon King's ancient signet ring, lost on the battlefield, contained a soul-tether spell that automatically bonded her dying spirit with a newborn in the closest human borderland.
clues: A faint, circular mark resembling the signet ring is branded onto the player's left palm.
Whispers from travelers that the Hero kept the Demon King's treasures, but her ring was never found.

known_facts: The Demon King was slain by the Hero Aiden in her dark throne room.
The Holy Empire regularly tests rural children for magical potential to draft them into imperial academies.
Oakhaven is a quiet, small village far from the grand conflicts of mages and demons.

opening.situation: You open your eyes in a drafty wooden attic, staring at your small, dirt-smudged hands as Martha, your new mother, calls you down for breakfast.

world.summary: The supreme Demon King has been slain, only to wake up in the fragile body of Elvi, a ten-year-old human girl in a quiet village. Stripped of your terrible power but keeping all of your memories, you must find a way to rebuild your strength from scratch. All the while, the empire's eyes draw closer, testing children for the very magic you must hide.

character.name: Elvi
character.description: A quiet, observant girl who speaks with a maturity far beyond her ten years.
character.appearance: Short, untidy dark hair, striking gray eyes that hold an ancient depth, wearing a oversized patched tunic and simple leather shoes.

traits.name: Demon King's Mind
traits.description: You remember every spell formula, tactical formation, and dark secret of your past life.

traits.name: Frail Vessel
traits.description: Your physical body is young, easily exhausted, and has undeveloped mana veins.

talents.name: Mana comprehension
talents.covers: learning and shaping magical circles and mana structures

talents.name: Demon Eye
talents.covers: perceiving hidden flows of magic and spiritual intent in others
talents.reason: Retained the spiritual sight of her former sovereign self.

fears: being discovered and executed before reclaiming her power
wants: Reclaim my lost power and find out what happened to my realm

items.name: Wooden Doll
items.description: A simple, hand-carved doll given to you by Martha.

connections.name: Martha
connections.note: Your human mother in this new life, who cares for you deeply.

backstory: Once, you were the supreme sovereign of the Demon Realm, ruling with an iron fist until the Hero Aiden breached your castle and struck you down.
Instead of fading into oblivion, you awoke in the body of Elvi, a frail ten-year-old human girl in the remote village of Oakhaven, with all your vast memories but none of your magic.
